title_zh: 找到工作坊管理员并取消重复报名

scenario.label_zh: 找到工作坊管理员并取消重复报名
scenario.goal_zh: 确认取消重复报名属于管理事务，保留一个名额并取得取消记录

context_zh: 学员到课程服务台处理自己重复提交的工作坊报名。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: I seem to have registered twice for the pottery workshop. Can I withdraw the second booking without losing the first?

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: Yes. That's an administrative matter rather than a teaching question. I'm the course administrator; I can check both references.

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: Here they are. Both are in my name for the same Saturday session.

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: I can see the duplicate. Neither booking has a payment attached. Shall I cancel the later one and retain the earlier place?

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: Yes, please. I only need one place.

sentences.speaker: Sol
sentences.text: Done. Here's the cancellation record for the later booking, and the earlier one is still active.

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: The two references match. Thank you for sorting it out.
